newsitem.title: INDIA: Hospitals say 57 dead in Delhi cinema fire.
newsitem.headline: Hospitals say 57 dead in Delhi cinema fire.

text.p: At least 57 people died and more than 90 were injured on Friday in a fire that tore through a jam-packed cinema hall in the Indian capital, hospital authorities said.
Officials at the All India Institute of Medical Sciences (AIIMS), a government-run hospital, said they had counted 41 bodies.
Uday Sahai, a deputy commissioner of police in the Indian capital, told Reuters at least 16 bodies had been brought to the nearby Safdarjung Hospital.
Rescue officials said at least 37 injured were brought to AIIMS and 67 to Safdarjung hospital.

The cinema hall was full for a matinee screening of a popular Hindi movie. Fire officials said the fire started when an electrical transformer on the ground floor exploded and set fire to cars in an adjacent parking lot.
